release_label: Pepforge V5.0.0 — Public Research Source Release
patch_notes: SPPS Planner V5.0.0 Public/Data-Sanitized logic remains available without private experimental seed data.
PDE retains Pareto NSGA-II candidate selection and explicit scientific design objectives.
V5 integrates structure generation, native docking, interaction analysis, validation tooling, and synthesis-planning hand-off.
Public release excludes private experimental history, credentials, internal handover files, and development-only release notes.
